subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman Make My Week, How to Sell 50,000 Books with Self-Publishing, The Art of Being Stubborn, Molly’s New Water Bottle, and More

bullets.title: Deadpool & Wolverine & The Bachelorette
bullets.creator: Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman
bullets.note: and [Hugh Jackman](https://www.instagram.com/TheHughJackman/). Even in my wildest dreams, I never could’ve seen this one coming. What a great surprise!

bullets.section: New Paul Graham essay I’m reading
bullets.title: The Right Kind of Stubborn
bullets.note: I especially like the first half of this essay plus the synopsis in the last two paragraphs. Great distinctions to keep in mind, such that you keep an open mind.

bullets.title: How I sold 50,000 copies of my self-published book
bullets.note: If you prefer reading, Paul also shares the details of royalties and sales per platform (Kindle, Audible, etc.) [in this blog post](https://newsletter.pathlesspath.com/p/i-sold-50k-books-and-i-didnt-predict). The full breakdown is under the “Money, Money, Money” subheading. I personally found the real-world examples of self-publishing vs. traditional publishing economics most interesting, and the “Mistakes” section is worth heeding for anyone considering self-publishing.

bullets.section: What I’m using when hiking with Molly
bullets.title: Springer Dog Water Bottle
bullets.note: If it’s hot or humid, my dear Molly pup gets parched. I bring water on hikes, but it’s always been at least 50% for naught. I pour it in my cupped hands and lose nearly all of it. Or if I use a collapsible bowl, she’ll drink a few sips and waste the rest. The Springer travel water bottle solves all of these problems. There are many other companies that make similar products, and I’m sure some are great, but this model was gifted to me and delivers. I have the Growler (44 oz) in Sky Blue.

bullets.title: Scientists and Experts Endorse MDMA-Assisted Therapy for PTSD
bullets.note: Read and share this letter, undersigned by 20+ well-known scientists and clinicians, expressing their position that MDMA is now approvable for use with therapy in the treatment of PTSD, given suitable safeguards and post-approval monitoring. The science is compelling.
